1	# Changes — rsc-service (all tagged releases through 2.0.5 / 3.0.5)
2	
3	Source: `git log`/`git show` on the `rsc-service` repository (all tags `0.0.1` → `2.0.5`,
4	`3.0.5`), cross-referenced with `output/context.md`.
5	Analyzed: 2026-08-31 (run_id `2026-08-31`)
6	
7	## Scope note (read first)
8	This repo has two eras: an original build-out from **2022-06-24 to 2023-02-17** (tags `0.0.1`
9	through `1.0.8`, ~360 commits), then a **19-month gap**, then an active relaunch from
10	**2025-10-13 to 2026-01-20** (tags `2.0.0` through `2.0.5`/`3.0.5`, ~78 commits). Per the
11	request to cover all releases, both eras are included below. The 2022–2023 era is summarized
12	as consolidated, theme-level entries (dozens of individual commits grouped) since those
13	releases already shipped years ago and granular per-commit detail no longer serves current test
14	planning; the 2025–2026 era is itemized at commit level since it is the active release train.
15	Every entry still cites concrete commit hashes.
16	
17	**Important history caveat**: tag `2.0.1` (2025-10-29, Hazelcast→Redis migration) is **not** an
18	ancestor of the current `HEAD`/`2.0.5`. The mainline that produced `2.0.2` onward branched from
19	`2.0.0` directly and re-did the Hazelcast removal a different way (MariaDB + Caffeine instead of
20	Redis). See **Unclear / Needs Clarification** — testers should not assume Redis is part of the
21	shipped system even though a `2.0.1` tag exists.
22	
23	## Summary (change count by category)
24	- Breaking Changes: 9
25	- New Features: 8
26	- Enhancements: 9
27	- Bug Fixes: 8 (current era) + 1 consolidated legacy entry (dozens of commits)
28	- Refactors / Internal: 5
29	- Config / Infra: 10
30	- Unclear / Needs Clarification: 5
31	
32	## Breaking Changes
33	
34	- **JDK 17 → 21 upgrade, all three modules** — `rsc-service-parent`, `rsc-service-api`,
35	  `rsc-report-viewer`, `rsc-data-loader` all retargeted from JDK 17 to JDK 21, alongside Spring
36	  Boot 2.7.0 → 3.4.5 and Spring Cloud 2021.0.3 → 2024.0.0. Affected: whole project (build/runtime
37	  target). Ref: `5108ae2`, `18b9627`, `4fff795`, `09a5029` (release `2.0.0`)
38	- **Spring Boot further bumped 3.4.5 → 3.4.6 → 3.5.6; Spring Cloud → 2025.0.0** during the same
39	  release window. Affected: whole project. Ref: `68528d8`, `1f8da42`, `fc81b34` (release `2.0.0`)
40	- **`rsc-report-viewer` login mechanism replaced with Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC** — adds
41	  `spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client`, a `KeycloakUtil`/`AuthoritiesConverter` for role mapping,
42	  a custom Keycloak login theme, and rewrites `SecurityConfiguration`/`LoginController`. The
43	  previous explicit `.requestMatchers("/reporting/**").hasAnyRole("ADMIN","USER")` rule was
44	  removed in favor of a generic `.anyRequest().authenticated()`, and the logout matcher changed
45	  from an `AntPathRequestMatcher` to `logoutUrl(...)`. Affected: `rsc-report-viewer` auth/session.
46	  Ref: `33aa81d`, `8085764`, `d89ae70`, `6e75246`, `318c77f` (release `2.0.0`)
47	- **Spring Actuator exposed on both `rsc-service-api` and `rsc-report-viewer`** with
48	  `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include: "*"` and `/actuator`, `/actuator/**`
49	  explicitly `permitAll()` (unauthenticated) in `rsc-report-viewer`'s security config; `db` and
50	  `diskspace` health indicators enabled. Affected: both modules' attack surface/monitoring.
51	  Ref: `d89ae70` (release `2.0.0`)
52	- **Hazelcast fully removed and replaced with a Caffeine (L1, per-instance) + MariaDB (L2,
53	  shared) hybrid cache, plus MariaDB-based distributed locking** — `hazelcast.xml` and the
54	  Hazelcast-based `DistributedTemplateLockManager` deleted from `rsc-data-loader`; new
55	  `CacheRepository`/`CacheRepositoryImpl`, `CacheConfiguration` (Caffeine), background
56	  `CacheSyncScheduler` and `CacheCleanupScheduler` added to `rsc-service-api`, backed by a new
57	  Liquibase-managed cache table (`data/config_db/changelog/V1_4__rsc_cache_table.sql`). This is a
58	  full architecture swap for both caching and cross-instance locking. Affected:
59	  `rsc-service-api` cache subsystem, `rsc-data-loader` locking, `config_db` schema. Ref: `97491d5`,
60	  `54b64d6`, `e569ef5`, `d1b1a33`, `b82c39a`, `e040a85`, `b1c0bf2`, `e417512`, `fddf8fb`,
61	  `3b993ef`, `8d61853` (release `2.0.2`)
62	- **MariaDB image upgraded 10.6.8 → 11.4** across all four dev DB Docker configs
63	  (`config_db`, `config_db_test`, `reporting_db`, `reporting_db_test`). Affected: local/dev DB
64	  infra; version-specific SQL/behavior differences are a risk between 10.6 and 11.4. Ref:
65	  `8996533` (release `2.0.0`)
66	- **[Legacy, 0.0.2] DB rename**: `users` table renamed to `user`, `roles` column renamed to
67	  `role`, with corresponding login-flow fixes. Affected: `rsc_config_db` schema,
68	  `rsc-report-viewer` login. Ref: `cca68f8`
69	- **[Legacy, 0.0.4] Password authentication converted to MD5 hashing** for `rsc-service-api`
70	  user auth. Affected: `rsc-service-api` auth. Ref: `4f29b14`, `a27b73a`
71	- **[Legacy, 1.0.5] API response contract change**: requests for an invalid or not-found MSISDN
72	  now return `HTTP 200` with `roaming: false` instead of a `4xx`/error status. Affected:
73	  `rsc-service-api` `visitorInfo` response contract — any consumer checking HTTP status codes
74	  (rather than the payload) to detect "not found" is affected. Ref: `c94f4ab`, `62302ca`
75	
76	## New Features
77	
78	- **Hybrid L1/L2 distributed MSISDN cache** for `rsc-service-api`: Caffeine in-memory L1 per
79	  instance, MariaDB-backed shared L2, with a 30s-interval sync scheduler and a cleanup scheduler
80	  for expired entries, plus TTL-unit configuration. Affected: `rsc-service-api` `cache/` package.
81	  Ref: `e040a85`, `b82c39a`, `b1c0bf2`, `e417512`, `fddf8fb`, `3b993ef`, `6a3d468` (releases
82	  `2.0.2`–`2.0.4`)
83	- **MariaDB-based distributed locking** for `rsc-data-loader`, replacing Hazelcast locks.
84	  Affected: `rsc-data-loader` `service/lock/DistributedTemplateLockManager`. Ref: `97491d5`
85	  (release `2.0.2`)
86	- **Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC login + custom login theme + profile/login pages** for
87	  `rsc-report-viewer`. Affected: `rsc-report-viewer` auth/UI. Ref: `33aa81d`, `6e75246`,
88	  `318c77f` (release `2.0.0`)
89	- **Spring Actuator health/monitoring endpoints** added to `rsc-service-api` and
90	  `rsc-report-viewer` (also a Breaking Change — see above for the exposure/security angle). Ref:
91	  `d89ae70` (release `2.0.0`)
92	- **Distributed tracing (Micrometer Tracing + Brave/Zipkin)** wired into both
93	  `rsc-data-loader` and `rsc-service-api` via new `TracingConfiguration` classes, fixing
94	  transaction-ID propagation into logs. `rsc-data-loader` also replaced
95	  `spring-cloud-starter-sleuth` with Micrometer Tracing directly. Affected: both modules'
96	  logging/tracing. Ref: `743d54e`, `4c76776`, `11ad80b` (release `2.0.0`/`2.0.2`)
97	- **SSL support added to `rsc-report-viewer`** (config-level, mirrors `rsc-service-api`). Ref:
98	  `cc9faac` (release `2.0.0`)
99	- **[Legacy, 0.0.4] WireMock-based `rsc-service-api-simulator`** added to fake SPML/HLR
100	  responses for testing. Ref: `c3e1bd5`
101	- **[Legacy, 1.0.5] Database indexes added** for query performance. Ref: `bcf207a`
102	
103	## Enhancements
104	
105	- **Cache TTL-by-VLR logic corrected**: non-neighbouring vs. neighbouring country cache
106	  expiry now derived from VLR rather than a flat TTL, in `DistributedMsisdnCacheManager`.
107	  Affected: `rsc-service-api` cache business logic. Ref: `5c0d862` (release `3.0.5`, commit
108	  message mislabeled "rsc-report-api" — actual diff touches `rsc-service-api`)
109	  — *this is the most recent product change in the repo and, per `context.md`, a priority
110	  regression area.*
111	- **TTL unit configuration added** to `CacheConfiguration`/`application.yml` (previously
112	  presumably a fixed/implicit unit). Ref: `6a3d468` (release `2.0.4`, also mislabeled
113	  "rsc-report-api" — actual diff is in `rsc-service-api`)
114	- **Cache/scheduler interval tuning**: `Schedulers` fixed-rate-ms values changed in
115	  `application.yml`. Ref: `e5e9fdb` (release `2.0.3`, mislabeled "rsc-report-api" —
116	  actual diff is in `rsc-service-api`)
117	- **HikariCP `maximum-pool-size` changed** in `rsc-service-api`'s `application.yml`. Ref:
118	  `23a0787` (release `2.0.2`)
119	- **Cache-layer logging improved/reconfigured** (`DistributedMsisdnCacheManager`,
120	  `CacheRepositoryImpl`, `CacheCleanupScheduler`, `CacheSyncScheduler`). Ref: `d1b48dd`,
121	  `933f077` (release `2.0.2`)
122	- **Node ID removed from `rsc-data-loader` distributed-lock logs.** Ref: `796660b` (release
123	  `2.0.2`)
124	- **Unit test coverage added** for `rsc-service-api` (general) and for the concurrent
125	  cache-eviction fix specifically. Ref: `d73cbb2`, `8a011f1`, `5cc5536` (releases `2.0.2`,
126	  `2.0.3`)
127	- **spml-gw connector version corrections.** Ref: `6838fc2`, `a7b400d` (release `2.0.0`)
128	- **[Legacy] Numerous SNMP alarm-message/key refinements and connection-pool/TPS-throttling
129	  tuning** consolidated across `1.0.0`–`1.0.5`. Ref: `cbd9414`, `b68fa1b`, representative of
130	  ~15 similar commits in that window.
131	
132	## Bug Fixes
133	
134	- **Fixed: certificate files (`.p12`/`.jks`) getting corrupted during build** — the Maven
135	  resource-copy/token-filter step now excludes `*.p12`/`*.jks` instead of running the
136	  `VERSION`-token filter over them. Affected: `rsc-service-api` build/packaging. Ref: `4e9e96e`
137	  (release `2.0.0`)
138	- **Fixed: TPS report CSV not downloading** — corrected the download link path in the
139	  `tps-utilization.html` template from `/reporting/download/tps-utilization/...` to
140	  `/download/tps-utilization/...`. Affected: `rsc-report-viewer` reporting UI — worth confirming
141	  this path change is consistent with the actual `ReportingController` route mapping. Ref:
142	  `599ce75` (release `2.0.0`)
143	- **Fixed: transaction ID not appearing in logs** — root-caused to missing tracing
144	  configuration; fixed by adding `TracingConfiguration` to both `rsc-data-loader` and
145	  `rsc-service-api` and adjusting `logback.xml`. Applied twice (once per module, different
146	  dates). Affected: both modules' log correlation. Ref: `743d54e`, `4c76776`
147	- **Fixed: concurrent cache-eviction issue** in `CacheSyncScheduler`. Affected: `rsc-service-api`
148	  cache. Ref: `e55f7a0` (release `2.0.3`, mislabeled "rsc-report-api" — actual diff is in
149	  `rsc-service-api`)
150	- **Fixed: non/neighbouring-country cache expiry based on VLR** (see also Enhancements —
151	  this is a correctness fix to previously-added cache-TTL logic, not a new capability). Ref:
152	  `5c0d862` (release `3.0.5`)
153	- **Fixed: typo** in `rsc-report-viewer`'s `messages_en.properties`. Ref: `da989dc` (release
154	  `2.0.3`)
155	- **[Legacy, dozens of commits, `0.0.2`–`1.0.8`]** Consolidated bug-fix theme covering: SNMP
156	  trap message/key corrections; trans-log/trx-events-log field printing (auth status, terminated
157	  IP, request status) issues; MSISDN/roaming validation edge cases; detail-transaction report
158	  search/pagination/CSV-download issues; TPS/error-summary report calculation errors; data-loader
159	  multi-node log-processing and log-rotation issues; DB migration/Liquibase script errors;
160	  disabling summary CSV generation via new config; dangling distributed-lock cleanup on restart.
161	  Each was tracked against an internal bug ID in the commit message (Bug 46025 through Bug
162	  46560). Representative refs: `d66c0ad`, `7a5033c`, `f5ba113`, `4f6ac8b`, `08ed272`, `1785328`,
163	  `a924424`, `fa3a642`, `4b30272`, `874dada`, `abcc80e`, `56a6c99`, `136b50e`, `9b633a8`,
164	  `45a8f9c`, `3b862b2` (releases `0.0.2` through `1.0.8`)
165	- **[Legacy, 1.0.2] Report Viewer security hardening batch**: CSRF tokens added, Content-Security-
166	  Policy header set, X-Frame-Options set, SameSite + Secure cookie flags set, third-party JS
167	  comments removed, bootstrap dependency upgraded. Affected: `rsc-report-viewer`. Ref: `c6eba65`,
168	  `a1179b1`, `2c2eb24`, `50e48a5`, `b722ec3`, `700a12c`, `1e1a852`
169	
170	## Refactors / Internal
171	
172	- **`spring-cloud-starter-sleuth` replaced by Micrometer Tracing** in `rsc-data-loader` (part of
173	  the JDK21/Spring upgrade). Ref: `11ad80b` (release `2.0.0`)
174	- **Hazelcast config/properties stripped from `application.yml`** for both `rsc-service-api` and
175	  `rsc-data-loader` once the MariaDB/Caffeine cache landed. Ref: `e569ef5`, `54b64d6` (release
176	  `2.0.2`)
177	- **[Legacy] Report-viewer module bootstrapped from the internal "xcap" project reference
178	  code**, then progressively converted from Kotlin to Java and refactored (routing, model
179	  attributes, DB access). Ref: `1054b7d`, `ae27cd7`, `20c0271` (releases `0.0.1`–`0.0.2`)
180	- **[Legacy] Logback configuration consolidated/standardized** across all three modules. Ref:
181	  `bf907ec` (release `1.0.2`)
182	- **[Legacy] Report-generation and stored-procedure logic refactored** multiple times in
183	  `rsc-data-loader` during initial build-out. Ref: `fe39922`, `8e77dc5`, `84b6284`

185	## Config / Infra
186	
187	- **Actuator exposure config** (see Breaking Changes) — `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include:
188	  "*"`, `base-path: /actuator`, `health.db`/`health.diskspace` enabled, `show-details: always`.
189	  Ref: `d89ae70`

192	- **`oauth2-client` dependency added** to `rsc-report-viewer/pom.xml`. Ref: `8085764` (release

- **SNMP traps** — `CommonSNMPManager` (internal `snmp-log-utils` lib) sends traps for DB errors, consecutive timeouts, high TPS, and app start/stop, via a configured shell script (`service-api.snmp.snmp-file-path: /hms/scripts/sample_snmp.sh`).
- **Distributed tracing** — Brave/Zipkin via Micrometer Tracing (`micrometer-tracing-bridge-brave`), trace ID surfaced in logs and as `X-Trace-Id`-style context (`Context.traceId`).
- **Liquibase** — schema migration/versioning for all four MariaDB schemas (`liquibase.sh`, `data/*/changelog`, `docker/docker-compose-db-migrate-*.yml`).

## Test Conventions
- **Framework**: JUnit 5 via `spring-boot-starter-test`, `mockk` (Kotlin-idiomatic mocking) and `mockito-kotlin` as mocking libraries, `reactor-test` for WebFlux/coroutine flows. Report viewer additionally uses `spring-security-test` and `kotlin-test`.
- **Layout**: mirrors main source package structure under `src/test/kotlin/...` (`rsc-service-api`) and `src/test/java/...` (`rsc-report-viewer`); one test class generally per main class (e.g. `DefaultSpmlConnectorAdapterTest.kt`, `VisitorAuthenticatorTest.kt`, `SecurityConfigurerTest.kt`, validator-specific tests under `validator/`).
- **Naming**: `<ClassUnderTest>Test.kt`/`.java`; some split across numbered files for large suites (`TpsLoggerImplTest`, `TpsLoggerImplTest1`, `2`, `3`).
- **Test config**: `rsc-service-api/src/test/resources/application.yml` overrides for test runs.
- **Local run**: `mvn clean install -DskipTest` for build; `docker-compose-dev-infa.yml` + `docker-compose-dev-test-infa.yml` for local infra, then `docker-compose-db-migrate-rsc-*-db.yml` / `*-test-db.yml` to create schemas (Readme.md). `data/initial-data/add-user.sql` seeds users; partitioning script must be run before load (`trx_events_log`, `trans_log`, `tps_log`).
- **External dependency simulation**: `simulators/rsc-service-simulator/` (WireMock) stands in for the SPML gateway with canned scenario mappings (roaming true/false, unauthorized, bad request, not-acceptable, internal error, delayed response) — useful for both manual and integration testing of `rsc-service-api` without a real HLR/VLR connection.

Not confirmed how/where automated tests run in CI. SonarQube scan is documented as a manual `mvn sonar:sonar` command (Readme.md), not confirmed to be wired into CI.

## Risk Notes
- **External SPML/HLR dependency is the critical path** — every roaming check calls out to the telecom Provisioning Gateway; `DefaultSpmlConnectorAdapter` wraps failures in generic `InternalErrorException`, and a documented open question in `docs/hld/hld_review.md` notes SPML connector delay/TPS is not fully understood ("What is the average delay for SPML connector at the moment", "Max tps for calling SPML is 50TPS... Need to monitor the SPML TPS"). Rate limiting is fixed at 50/s — worth confirming behavior under throttling/backpressure.
- **Hybrid cache correctness** — L1 (Caffeine, per-instance) vs L2 (MariaDB, shared) can diverge; sync runs every 30s, cleanup every 2min (`application.yml` `cache.sync.scheduler`, `cache.cleanup.scheduler`). The most recent product commit (`5c0d862`, tagged into release `2.0.5`, still HEAD's most recent product change as of this run) specifically touched `DistributedMsisdnCacheManager.kt` to "fix non & neighbouring countries cache time based on Vlr" — this cache-TTL-by-VLR logic remains the freshest change and should stay a priority regression-test area until a newer commit supersedes it. Multi-instance deployments should also be tested for stale-cache/race conditions, especially around `clear-cache`/`clear-all-cache` admin endpoints only clearing local vs distributed state.
- **Auth is custom, not framework-based, in rsc-service-api** — `VisitorAuthenticator` manually decodes Basic-Auth header and checks a DB-backed user table with a custom `PasswordService`; no Spring Security filter chain enforcing this, so any new route must remember to call `authenticate(...)` explicitly or it is unprotected by default (`RouteConfiguration.kt`).

- **MSISDN regex-driven business rules** are config-driven and easy to get subtly wrong: `service-api.roaming-inactive-msisdn`, `msisdn-validations.range`, `msisdn-status-cache.neighbouring-countries-vlrAddress` in `application.yml` directly control roaming/multi-sim/caching logic — any change to these regexes changes business behavior without a code change.
- **Log-to-report pipeline has multiple hops** (`rsc-service-api` writes trans/event logs → `rsc-data-loader` parses and loads into `rsc_reporting_db` → `rsc-report-viewer` reads/exports) — data can be lost or delayed at any hop; partitioning of `trx_events_log`/`trans_log`/`tps_log` must be pre-created or inserts fail (Readme.md warning).

- **SNMP alerting depends on an external shell script path** (`/hms/scripts/sample_snmp.sh`) — if missing/misconfigured in an environment, DB error / high-TPS / timeout alarms silently won't fire.

- Whether/where CI actually runs `mvn test`/`mvn verify` — no CI config file found in the repo (re-checked this run).
- Production Keycloak issuer/realm configuration (only a `localhost:8081` dev value was found).

1	package hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.cache
2	
3	import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache
4	import hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.cache.repository.CacheRepository
5	import hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.error.CommonError
6	import hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.error.InternalErrorException
7	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry
8	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
9	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
10	import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException
11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
12	import kotlin.Exception
13	
14	/**
15	 * Hybrid cache manager using two-tier architecture:
16	 * - L1: Caffeine (in-memory, per-instance, fast)
17	 * - L2: MariaDB (shared, distributed, persistent)
18	 * 
19	 * Provides near-real-time cross-instance consistency via invalidation polling
20	 * and eventual consistency via periodic sync scheduler (2-minute default).
21	 */
22	@Component
23	class DistributedMsisdnCacheManager(
24	    private val cacheRepository: CacheRepository,
25	    private val caffeineCache: Cache<String, CachedData>,
26	    private val meterRegistry: MeterRegistry,
27	    @Value("\${spring.application.name}") val nodeId: String,
28	    @Value("\${service-api.msisdn-status-cache.neighbouring-countries-vlrAddress}") val msisdnRegexList: List<String>,
29	    @Value("\${service-api.msisdn-status-cache.neighbouring-countries-cache-invalid-time-minutes}") val neighbouringCacheInvalidTimeMinutes: Long,
30	    @Value("\${service-api.msisdn-status-cache.non-neighbouring-countries-cache-invalid-time-minutes}") val nonNeighbouringCacheInvalidTimeMinutes: Long) {
31	
32	    companion object {
33	        private val LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DistributedMsisdnCacheManager::class.java)
34	    }
35	
36	    /**
37	     * Add entry to hybrid cache (L1 + L2)
38	     * 
39	     * Write path:
40	     * 1. Check if already in L1 cache
41	     * 2. Write to L2 (MariaDB) with TTL
42	     * 3. Update L1 (Caffeine) cache
43	     * 4. Trigger invalidation event for other instances
44	     * 
45	     * Graceful degradation: If L2 write fails, still updates L1 (degraded mode)
46	     */
47	    fun addToCache(msisdn: String, cacheData: CachedData) {
48	        if (!inCache(msisdn)) {
49	            LOGGER.info("Msisdn : [$msisdn] not in cache, adding data [$cacheData]")
50	            val startTime = System.nanoTime()
51	            
52	            try {
53	                val timeout = getTimeout(cacheData.vlrAddress)
54	                
55	                // Write to L2 (MariaDB) - triggers invalidation log via DB trigger
56	                cacheRepository.upsert(msisdn, cacheData, timeout)
57	                
58	                // Update L1 (Caffeine)
59	                caffeineCache.put(msisdn, cacheData)
60	                
61	                val duration = System.nanoTime() - startTime
62	                LOGGER.debug(
63	                    "Added to cache msisdn: [{}], data: [{}], duration: [{}ms], node: [{}]",
64	                    msisdn,
65	                    cacheData,
66	                    duration / 1_000_000,
67	                    nodeId
68	                )
69	                
70	                // Record metrics
71	                meterRegistry.counter("cache.write", "status", "success", "node", nodeId).increment()
72	                meterRegistry.timer("cache.write.duration", "node", nodeId).record(duration, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)
73	                
74	            } catch (e: DataAccessException) {
75	                // MariaDB write failed - degraded mode (L1 only)
76	                LOGGER.error(
77	                    "L2 (MariaDB) write failed for [$msisdn], falling back to L1-only mode", e
78	                )
79	                
80	                // Still update L1 cache for temporary availability
81	                caffeineCache.put(msisdn, cacheData)
82	                
83	                // Record failure metrics
84	                meterRegistry.counter("cache.write", "status", "l2_failure", "node", nodeId).increment()

1	package hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.cache.repository.Impl
2	
3	import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
4	import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.readValue
5	import hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.cache.CachedData
6	import hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.cache.repository.CacheRepository
7	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
8	import org.springframework.dao.EmptyResultDataAccessException
9	import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate
10	import org.springframework.jdbc.core.RowMapper
11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository
12	
13	/**
14	 * JDBC implementation of CacheRepository using MariaDB
15	 * 
16	 * Provides ACID transactions for cache operations and handles
17	 * JSON serialization for complex types (Msisdns list).
18	 */
19	@Repository
20	class CacheRepositoryImpl(
21	    private val jdbcTemplate: JdbcTemplate,
22	    private val objectMapper: ObjectMapper
23	) : CacheRepository {
24	    
25	    companion object {
26	        @JvmStatic
27	        private val LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CacheRepositoryImpl::class.java)
28	    }
29	    
30	    private val cachedDataRowMapper = RowMapper<CachedData> { rs, _ ->
31	        CachedData(
32	            roamingStatus = rs.getBoolean("roaming_status"),
33	            multiSim = rs.getObject("multi_sim") as Boolean?,
34	            memberMsisdns = parseMemberMsisdns(rs.getString("member_msisdns")),
35	            vlrAddress = rs.getString("vlr_address") ?: ""
36	        )
37	    }
38	    
39	    private val cacheEntryRowMapper = RowMapper<Pair<String, CachedData>> { rs, _ ->
40	        val msisdn = rs.getString("id")
41	        val data = CachedData(
42	            roamingStatus = rs.getBoolean("roaming_status"),
43	            multiSim = rs.getObject("multi_sim") as Boolean?,
44	            memberMsisdns = parseMemberMsisdns(rs.getString("member_msisdns")),
45	            vlrAddress = rs.getString("vlr_address") ?: ""
46	        )
47	        msisdn to data
48	    }
49	    
50	    override fun get(msisdn: String): CachedData? {
51	        return try {
52	            jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
53	                """
54	                SELECT roaming_status, multi_sim, member_msisdns, vlr_address
55	                FROM cached_data_table
56	                WHERE id = ? AND expires_at > NOW()
57	                """,
58	                cachedDataRowMapper,
59	                msisdn
60	            )
61	        } catch (e: EmptyResultDataAccessException) {
62	            LOGGER.debug("Returned empty cache entry for msisdn[$msisdn]")
63	            null
64	        }
65	    }
66	    
67	    override fun upsert(msisdn: String, data: CachedData, ttlMinutes: Long) {
68	        val memberMsisdnsJson = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(data.memberMsisdns)
69	        
70	        val rowsAffected = jdbcTemplate.update(
71	            """
72	            INSERT INTO cached_data_table 
73	            (id, roaming_status, multi_sim, member_msisdns, vlr_address, expires_at)
74	            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW() + INTERVAL ? MINUTE)
75	            ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
76	                roaming_status = VALUES(roaming_status),
77	                multi_sim = VALUES(multi_sim),
78	                member_msisdns = VALUES(member_msisdns),
79	                vlr_address = VALUES(vlr_address),
80	                expires_at = VALUES(expires_at),
81	                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
82	            """,
83	            msisdn,
84	            data.roamingStatus,
85	            data.multiSim,
86	            memberMsisdnsJson,
87	            data.vlrAddress,
88	            ttlMinutes
89	        )
90	        
91	        LOGGER.debug("Upserted cache entry for [$msisdn], rows affected: [$rowsAffected]")
92	    }
93	    
94	    override fun delete(msisdn: String): CachedData? {
95	        // Retrieve before delete
96	        val cachedData = get(msisdn)
97	        
98	        if (cachedData != null) {
99	            val rowsDeleted = jdbcTemplate.update(
100	                "DELETE FROM cached_data_table WHERE id = ?",
101	                msisdn
102	            )
103	            LOGGER.debug("Deleted cache entry for [$msisdn], rows deleted: [$rowsDeleted]")
104	        }
105	        
106	        return cachedData
107	    }
108	    
109	    override fun deleteAll(): Int {
110	        val rowsDeleted = jdbcTemplate.update("DELETE FROM cached_data_table")
111	        LOGGER.debug("Deleted all cache entries, rows deleted: [$rowsDeleted]")
112	        return rowsDeleted
113	    }
114	    
115	    override fun getAllActive(): List<Pair<String, CachedData>> {
116	        val result =  jdbcTemplate.query(
117	            """
118	            SELECT id, roaming_status, multi_sim, member_msisdns, vlr_address
119	            FROM cached_data_table
120	            WHERE expires_at > NOW()
121	            ORDER BY updated_at DESC
122	            """,
123	            cacheEntryRowMapper
124	        )
125	
126	        LOGGER.debug("Returned all active cache entries, rows: [${result.size}]")
127	
128	        return result
129	    }
130	    
131	    override fun cleanupExpired(): Int {
132	        val rowsDeleted = jdbcTemplate.update(
133	            "DELETE FROM cached_data_table WHERE expires_at <= NOW()"
134	        )
135	        
136	        if (rowsDeleted > 0) {
137	            LOGGER.debug("Deleted expired cache entries, rows deleted: [$rowsDeleted]")
138	        }
139	        
140	        return rowsDeleted
141	    }
142	    
143	    override fun count(): Int {
144	        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
145	            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cached_data_table WHERE expires_at > NOW()",
146	            Int::class.java
147	        ) ?: 0
148	    }
149	    
150	    /**
151	     * Parse JSON array string to List<String>
152	     * Handles null and empty cases gracefully
153	     */
154	    private fun parseMemberMsisdns(json: String?): List<String> {
155	        if (json.isNullOrBlank()) return emptyList()
156	        
157	        return try {
158	            objectMapper.readValue<List<String>>(json)
159	        } catch (e: Exception) {
160	            LOGGER.error("Failed to parse member_msisdns JSON: [$json]", e)
161	            emptyList()
162	        }
163	    }
164	}

2	
3	import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache
4	import hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.cache.CachedData
5	import hms.core.m1.rsc.rscservice.cache.repository.CacheRepository
6	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry
7	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
8	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
9	import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty
10	import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled
11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
12	import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
13	
14	/**
15	 * Scheduler to synchronize L1 (Caffeine) cache from L2 (MariaDB)
16	 * 
17	 * Runs periodically to ensure eventual consistency across all instances:
18	 * - Fetches all active cache entries from MariaDB
19	 * - Updates local Caffeine cache with fresh data
20	 * - Provides up to 2-minute consistency guarantee (configurable via fixed rate)
21	 * 
22	 * This scheduler is the primary mechanism for cross-instance cache coherence
23	 * in the hybrid cache architecture.
24	 */
25	@Component
26	@ConditionalOnProperty(
27	    prefix = "cache.sync.scheduler",
28	    name = ["enabled"],
29	    havingValue = "true",
30	    matchIfMissing = true
31	)
32	class CacheSyncScheduler(
33	    private val cacheRepository: CacheRepository,
34	    private val caffeineCache: Cache<String, CachedData>,
35	    private val meterRegistry: MeterRegistry,
36	    @Value("\${spring.application.name}") private val nodeId: String
37	) {
38	    
39	    companion object {
40	        @JvmStatic
41	        private val LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CacheSyncScheduler::class.java)
42	    }
43	    
44	    /**
45	     * Sync L1 cache from L2 database
46	     * 
47	     * Default: runs every 2 minutes (120000ms) with 30s initial delay
48	     * Can be configured via cache.sync.scheduler.fixed-rate-ms
49	     */
50	    @Scheduled(
51	        fixedRateString = "\${cache.sync.scheduler.fixed-rate-ms:120000}",
52	        initialDelayString = "\${cache.sync.scheduler.initial-delay-ms:30000}"
53	    )
54	    fun syncCacheFromDatabase() {
55	        val startTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
56	        
57	        try {
58	            LOGGER.debug("Starting cache sync from L2 cache")
59	            
60	            // Fetch all active entries from MariaDB
61	            val allEntries = cacheRepository.getAllActive()
62	            
63	            // Get current L1 cache keys for comparison
64	            val currentL1Keys = HashSet(caffeineCache.asMap().keys)
65	            val l2Keys = allEntries.map { it.first }.toSet()
66	            
67	            // Update L1 cache
68	            var updatedCount = 0
69	            var newCount = 0
70	            var unchangedCount = 0
71	            var deletedCount = 0
72	            
73	            allEntries.forEach { (msisdn, data) ->
74	                val existingData = caffeineCache.getIfPresent(msisdn)
75	                
76	                when {
77	                    existingData == null -> {
78	                        // New entry - add to cache
79	                        caffeineCache.put(msisdn, data)
80	                        newCount++
81	                    }
82	                    existingData != data -> {
83	                        // Data changed - update cache
84	                        caffeineCache.put(msisdn, data)
85	                        updatedCount++
86	                    }
87	                    else -> {
88	                        // Data unchanged - skip update
89	                        unchangedCount++
90	                    }
91	                }
92	            }
93	            
94	            // Remove entries from L1 that don't exist in L2 (deleted entries)
95	            val keysToDelete: Set<String> = currentL1Keys - l2Keys
96	            keysToDelete.forEach { msisdn: String ->
97	                caffeineCache.invalidate(msisdn)
98	                deletedCount++
99	            }
100	            
101	            val duration = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime
102	            
103	            LOGGER.info(
104	                "Cache sync completed: total=[${allEntries.size}], new=[$newCount], " +
105	                "updated=[$updatedCount], unchanged=[$unchangedCount], deleted=[$deletedCount], duration=[${duration}ms]"
106	            )
107	            
108	            // Record metrics
109	            meterRegistry.counter("cache.sync.success", "node", nodeId).increment()
110	            meterRegistry.timer("cache.sync.duration", "node", nodeId).record(duration, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
111	            meterRegistry.gauge("cache.sync.entries.total", listOf(), allEntries.size)
112	            meterRegistry.gauge("cache.sync.entries.new", listOf(), newCount)
113	            meterRegistry.gauge("cache.sync.entries.updated", listOf(), updatedCount)
114	            meterRegistry.gauge("cache.sync.entries.unchanged", listOf(), unchangedCount)
115	            meterRegistry.gauge("cache.sync.entries.deleted", listOf(), deletedCount)
116	            
117	        } catch (e: Exception) {
118	            LOGGER.error("Cache sync failed", e)
119	            meterRegistry.counter("cache.sync.failure", "node", nodeId).increment()
120	        }
121	    }
122	    
123	    /**
124	     * Get current cache statistics for monitoring
125	     */
126	    fun getCacheStats(): Map<String, Any> {
127	        val stats = caffeineCache.stats()
128	        return mapOf(
129	            "hitCount" to stats.hitCount(),
130	            "missCount" to stats.missCount(),
131	            "hitRate" to stats.hitRate(),
132	            "evictionCount" to stats.evictionCount(),
133	            "estimatedSize" to caffeineCache.estimatedSize()
134	        )
135	    }
136	}

11	import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
12	
13	/**
14	 * Configuration for Caffeine L1 cache and scheduling components
15	 * 
16	 * Caffeine provides high-performance in-memory caching with:
17	 * - Size-based eviction (LFU algorithm)
18	 * - Time-based expiration
19	 * - Statistics recording for monitoring
20	 */
21	@Configuration
22	@EnableScheduling
23	class CacheConfiguration {
24	    
25	    companion object {
26	        @JvmStatic
27	        private val LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CacheConfiguration::class.java)
28	    }
29	    
30	    /**
31	     * Create Caffeine cache bean for L1 (in-memory) cache layer
32	     * 
33	     * Configuration:
34	     * - maximumSize: 100 entries per instance (matches Hazelcast config)
35	     * - expireAfterWrite: 240 minutes (max TTL for non-neighboring MSISDNs)
36	     * - recordStats: Enable metrics collection
37	     * 
38	     * @param maxSize Maximum number of entries in L1 cache
39	     * @param ttlMinutes TTL for cache entries (will be overridden by DB TTL on sync)
40	     */
41	    @Bean
42	    fun caffeineCache(
43	        @Value("\${cache.caffeine.max-size:100}") maxSize: Long,
44	        @Value("\${cache.caffeine.ttl-duration:240}") ttlDuration: Long,
45	        @Value("\${cache.caffeine.ttl-unit:MINUTES}") ttlUnit: TimeUnit
46	    ): Cache<String, CachedData> {
47	        LOGGER.info("Initializing Caffeine L1 cache with maxSize=[$maxSize], ttl=[$ttlDuration] $ttlUnit")
48	        
49	        return Caffeine.newBuilder()
50	            .maximumSize(maxSize)
51	            .expireAfterWrite(ttlDuration, ttlUnit)
52	            .recordStats()
53	            .removalListener<String, CachedData> { key, _, cause ->
54	                LOGGER.debug("L1 cache eviction: key=[{}], cause=[{}]", key, cause)
55	            }
56	            .build()
57	    }
58	}

44	    var odboc: String? = null,
45	    var servedFromCache: Boolean = false,
46	    var multiSim: Boolean? = null,
47	    var childNumberRoaming: List<SpmlData> = listOf(),
48	    private val statusChain: HashMap<String, Boolean> = hashMapOf(),
49	    val receivedTimeMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
50	    val receivedTime: LocalDateTime = LocalDateTime.now()
51	) {
52	    fun addToStatusChain(step: String, status: Boolean) {
53	        statusChain[step] = status
54	    }
55	
56	    fun getStatusChain() = statusChain
57	
58	    // Duplicate of this function is available in SpmlData class as well.
59	    fun isRoaming(callBarringStatusInactive: String, inactiveMsisdnRegex: String) =
60	        (odboc != null && odboc == callBarringStatusInactive) && !(vlrAddress == null || Regex(inactiveMsisdnRegex).matches(vlrAddress?: ""))
61	}
62	
63	sealed interface RoamingStatusCheckResult
64	class RoamingStatusCheckSuccess(val respBody: ApiResponse) : RoamingStatusCheckResult
65	class RoamingStatusCheckFailure(val httpStatusCode: HttpStatus) : RoamingStatusCheckResult
66	
67	data class ApiResponse(val roaming: Boolean)
68	
69	@Component
70	class WorkflowChainImpl(
71	    val transLogger: TransLogger,
72	    val numberLengthValidator: NumberLengthValidator,
73	    val numberRangeValidator: NumberRangeValidator,
74	    val spmlExistsValidator: SpmlExistsValidator,
75	    val singleMsisdnRoamingValidator: SingleMsisdnRoamingValidator,
76	    val checkInCache: CheckInCache,
77	    val distributedMsisdnCacheManager: DistributedMsisdnCacheManager,
78	    val multiSimStatusValidator: MultiSimStatusValidator,
79	    @Value("\${service-api.msisdn-status-cache.enable-cache}") private val enableCache: Boolean,
80	    @Value("\${service-api.roaming-inactive-msisdn}") private val inactiveMsisdnRegex: String,
81	    @Value("\${service-api.call-barring-status-inactive}") private val callBarringStatusInactive: String
82	) : WorkflowChain {
83	
84	    companion object {
85	        @JvmStatic
86	        private val LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(WorkflowChain::class.java)
87	    }
88	
89	    @PostConstruct
90	    fun buildChain() {
91	        numberLengthValidator.setNextStep(numberRangeValidator)
92	        numberRangeValidator.setNextStep(checkInCache)
93	        checkInCache.setNextStep(spmlExistsValidator)
94	        spmlExistsValidator.setNextStep(singleMsisdnRoamingValidator)
95	        singleMsisdnRoamingValidator.setNextStep(multiSimStatusValidator)
96	    }
97	
98	    override suspend fun processRequest(context: Context): RoamingStatusCheckResult {
99	        LOGGER.info("Start processing request [$context]")
100	        val result = try {
101	            val resp = numberLengthValidator.processRequest(context)
102	            LOGGER.info("Finished processing request for msisdn [${context.msisdn}] context[$context] result[$resp]")
103	            transLogger.printTransLog(context, resp)
104	            resp
105	        } catch (ex: Throwable) {
106	            val resp = WorkflowStepFailure(InternalErrorException(CommonStatus("Internal Error")))
107	            LOGGER.error("Unexpected error occurred", ex)
108	            transLogger.printTransLog(context, resp)
109	            resp
110	        }
111	
112	        return when (result) {
113	            is WorkflowStepSuccess -> {
114	                addToCache(context)
115	                if (context.roamingStatus != null) {
116	                    RoamingStatusCheckSuccess(ApiResponse(context.roamingStatus!!))
117	                } else {
118	                    RoamingStatusCheckSuccess(ApiResponse(false))
119	                }
120	            }
121	            is WorkflowStepFailure -> RoamingStatusCheckFailure(result.error.status)
122	        }
123	    }
124	
125	    private fun addToCache(context: Context) {
126	        if (context.roamingStatus == true && enableCache) {
127	            distributedMsisdnCacheManager.addToCache(
128	                context.msisdn, CachedData(
129	                    roamingStatus = context.roamingStatus == true,
130	                    multiSim = context.multiSim,
131	                    memberMsisdns = context.childNumberRoaming.map { it.msisdn },
132	                    vlrAddress = context.vlrAddress ?: "",
133	                )
134	            )
135	            if (context.multiSim == true) {
136	                context.childNumberRoaming
137	                    .filter { it.isRoaming(callBarringStatusInactive, inactiveMsisdnRegex) }
138	                    .forEach {
139	                        distributedMsisdnCacheManager.addToCache(
140	                            it.msisdn, CachedData(
141	                                roamingStatus = true,
142	                                multiSim = context.multiSim,
143	                                memberMsisdns = listOf(),
144	                                vlrAddress = it.isdnNumberOfVLR ?: "",
145	                            )
146	                        )
147	                    }
148	            }
149	        }
150	    }

-- Migration: Add hybrid cache table for MariaDB + Caffeine cache implementation
-- Purpose: Replace Hazelcast distributed cache with MariaDB-backed cache
-- Date: 2025-11-24

-- Main cache table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cached_data_table (
    id VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY COMMENT 'MSISDN - cache key',
    roaming_status BOOLEAN NOT NULL COMMENT 'Whether MSISDN is in roaming',
    multi_sim BOOLEAN COMMENT 'Whether this is a multi-SIM subscription',
    member_msisdns JSON COMMENT 'List of member MSISDNs for multi-SIM (JSON array)',
    vlr_address VARCHAR(255) COMMENT 'VLR address from HLR lookup',
    expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL COMMENT 'TTL enforcement - entry expires after this timestamp',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'Last update timestamp',
    INDEX idx_expires (expires_at) COMMENT 'Index for cleanup scheduler',
    INDEX idx_updated_at (updated_at) COMMENT 'Index for sync scheduler'
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Hybrid cache storage for MSISDN roaming status';

# Code Scan — rsc-service (all tagged releases through 2.0.5 / 3.0.5)

Scope: files/modules named in `output/changes.md` (run `2026-08-31`) — actuator/security config
(`rsc-service-api`, `rsc-report-viewer`), the Hazelcast→Caffeine+MariaDB hybrid cache subsystem
(`rsc-service-api/cache/**`), Keycloak OAuth2 login (`rsc-report-viewer/configuration/**`,
`util/KeycloakUtil.java`), the TPS CSV download fix (`tps-utilization.html` and sibling report
templates), the MSISDN validation/response-contract change
(`NumberLengthValidator.kt`, `NumberRangeValidator.kt`, `SpmlExistsValidator.kt`), legacy MD5
password hashing (`PasswordService.kt`), the MariaDB distributed lock manager
(`DistributedTemplateLockManager.kt`), tracing configuration, and related `application.yml`
changes. Reviewed against the actual `rsc-service` working tree at `HEAD` (`2828ad6`, tag
`2.0.5`), which matches `context.md`'s confirmation of no uncommitted product source changes.
Analyzed: 2026-08-31
Status: ADVISORY — feeds test-planner's risk rating; does not block the pipeline

## Blocker

- **`rsc-service-api/src/main/resources/application.yml:30-44`** — All Spring Actuator endpoints
  are exposed (`management.endpoints.web.exposure.include: "*"`, base path `/actuator`) and
  `rsc-service-api` has no Spring Security dependency at all (confirmed no
  `spring-boot-starter-security`/`spring-security` entry in `rsc-service-api/pom.xml`), so every
  actuator endpoint — including `/actuator/env`, `/actuator/heapdump`, `/actuator/threaddump`,
  `/actuator/beans`, `/actuator/mappings` — is reachable by anyone with network access, with no
  login of any kind. Combined with the plaintext default credentials sitting in the same file
  (DB password `password` at line 19, SSL keystore/key passwords `password` at lines 6 and 9),
  anyone who can reach this port can pull the running configuration (env vars, datasource URL/
  credentials) and a full heap dump without authenticating. Related change: Breaking Changes /
  "Spring Actuator exposed on both `rsc-service-api` and `rsc-report-viewer`" (`d89ae70`).
